title: Absolutely Continuous Spectrum for Weak-Disorder Anderson Models in Dimensions at Least Three
main_claim: For each fixed d>=3 there is lambda_d>0 such that for every fixed 0<lambda<lambda_d, the Anderson operator on Z^d with iid uniform [-lambda,lambda] potentials almost surely has purely absolutely continuous spectrum, with nonzero weight, on a fixed interval just above the band bottom (I_3=(-6+e2/2,-6+e2), I_d=-2d+(1/200,1/100) for d>=4). The proof goes through a finite-volume damped-resolvent certificate (Prop 2.1) built by a multiscale digit-revealing construction.
coverage: I read every line of Sec 1, 2, 3, 8 and 9, plus large parts of Sec 4-6. I checked these steps by hand. Sec 9 readout: the Ward identity, the comparison of the Schur-complement column with C_R, the f_eta rank cut, M_eps = 1+eps^-2, the Phi summation and Wegner constants (8 eps/lambda <= c*/8), the volume comparison, boundary nonvanishing, rank-one propagation and the Simon-Wolff/Shamis purity step. Sec 3: the scalar fixed point, the two-resolvent absolute-product bound, smallness of K and of the fourth-power rows, the gap of 1-F-hat, and the three initial comparisons. Sec 4: the port duplication identities, the single-deletion Sherman-Morrison formula and gamma moments, and the exact Schur identities for J and L. Sec 5: the one-trial matrix-martingale concentration (exponent margins) and the tile-to-sweep transfer. Sec 6: core completion via the range of the scattering cross block (Delta S = Pi Delta S Pi-bar, the entry and row bounds), range localization by exponential conjugation, and the conditional leverage drift (every error exponent checked against delta, nu, e0, beta_w). Sec 8: the chronological product bound, witness extraction and packing counts, the recursion closing, the cutoff, and the threshold definition. I did NOT fully verify: the Laplacian, lag and fourth-power increment stacks in Sec 4 (lines ~330-1245), the local pullback (Sec 5), the clearing-trial failure probability and heat count (end of Sec 6), and the assembly, geometry and diagonal-reset induction (Sec 7). Because the claim is at the level of the extended-states conjecture, the unverified Sec 4 and 7 stacks are where a deeper audit should look. The only oddity I found is expository and not a gap: e_2 is called 'sufficiently small' but no step uses smallness beyond e_2<1/100.
